verdict.rationale: Factory's Droid CLI/exec can run shell commands, integrate with Git workflows, and cloud 'Droid Computers' offer ready-to-use sessions without local install, implying some autonomous environment setup, but there's no explicit documentation stating an agent automatically clones a repo and installs dependencies end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit workflow showing autonomous git clone + dependency install steps, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this exact flow.
